item.title: War in Middle East Live: Israeli military continues strikes in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
item.description: Israel continued its strikes on southern Lebanon on Friday killing seven overnight in the city of Tyre, including in an attack near a hospital. This despite a ceasefire agreement signed between Israel and Lebanon, which has been rejected by the Hezbollah militia whose leader called the negotiations “absurd, humiliating and insulting.” Follow the latest events in our liveblog.

item.title: Trump's acknowledgment of Hezbollah 'utterly humiliating' for Netanyahu
item.description: Israel continued to strike southern Lebanon on Tuesday as Iran-backed Hezbollah attacked its troops there despite an apparent Washington-brokered de-escalation deal and a fourth round of US-hosted talks between Lebanon and Israel. FRANCE 24's Jerusalem correspondent Noga Tarnopolsky explains that "on the Israeli side we have simply no acknowledgment of this deal", adding that seeing Trump acknowledge Hezbollah "has been an utter humiliation" for Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: 'Palestinians are unbelievable people: Vast majority of in Gaza just want to live a normal life'
item.description: Angela Diffley is pleased to welcome Dr. Adi Nadimpalli, Medical Coordinator for Gaza with Doctors Without Borders. He offers a stark assessment of conditions in Gaza following the October 2025 ceasefire. item.title: Ye Concerts Have Been Canceled Across Europe. Why Not in the Netherlands?
item.description: Lawmakers and Jewish groups lodged protests over the rapper’s history of antisemitism. But those sensitivities ran headlong into the Netherlands’ robust free speech protections.

item.title: My husband planned our 'just us' trip and it was perfect. Here's why it worked
item.description: For a smooth, rewarding and drama-free couples trip, take as much stress out of the equation as you can — and get comfortable with the fact that a fight may arise (and that's OK).

item.title: Backed by Trump, Opposed by Putin, and Fighting for His Political Life
item.description: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan of Armenia is seeking re-election as his country weighs questions of war and peace, of autocracy and democracy, and of subjugation and independence.

item.title: Xi to visit North Korea, showing China’s importance to a nuclear-armed neighbor
item.description: The summit comes as China positions itself as a global power player projecting stability in contrast to the U.S.'s economically damaging war against Iran and erratic tariff policies.

item.title: Hezbollah chief rejects truce as Israel vows continued operations in south Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah on Thursday rejected the latest ceasefire agreement between Israel and the Lebanese government, demanding a complete Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon as more fighting there hampered efforts to end the Iran war. The Hezbollah announcement came as Israeli strikes killed at least eight people, according to Lebanese authorities, and a UN peacekeeper was killed in the crossfire.

item.title: Israel strikes hospital in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israel continues to hit targets in Lebanon despite a partial US-brokered ceasefire in place. Lebanese and Israeli diplomats are in Washington for the fourth round of direct talks, but those negotiations have been strongly opposed by Hezbollah. Pressure also mounting within Netanyahu's own government to continue the war in Lebanon.

item.title: Hezbollah denounces Israel-Lebanon ceasefire deal as a ‘farce’
item.description: “We have given no commitment to anyone,” the Iranian-backed militant group's leader said after Israel and Lebanon announced a new U.S.-mediated agreement.
